semiconductor_relevance: High — Shin Nippon Air Technologies specializes in particle visualization systems that directly address cleanliness and defect rates in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Shin Nippon Air Technologies provides advanced fine particle visualization systems designed to enhance cleanliness and reduce defect rates in semiconductor manufacturing. Their ViEST brand technology combines ultra-high-sensitivity cameras and light sources to visualize and quantify minute particles in cleanrooms and equipment, offering real-time insights for process improvement.
capabilities: Contract technical services for semiconductor applications
